newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM Aug-April gold futures surge by daily limit.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM Aug-April gold futures surge by daily limit.

text.p: The August to April months of yen-based Tokyo gold futures surged by their 40 yen per gram daily limit in afternoon trade on Thursday after the dollar jumped against the yen, traders said.
Benchmark April gold rose by its 40 yen per gram daily limit to 1,258 yen, before easing to 1,255 yen by 0449 GMT.
The dollar jumped above 115 yen after senior Ministry of Finance official Eisuke Sakakibara said Japan would act decisively against excessive moves in the currency market.
"Bargain-hunting buying gathered force after the yen fell," one analyst at a commodity broker said.

The yen's sharp fall led to a view that gold prices were too low after some gold futures hit their life of contract lows on Wednesday. Spot gold was quoted at $342.10/60 at 0457 GMT, against $343.60/344.10 in New York on Wednesday.
